findings.text: the node's stated goal (prompt.txt:30) is the tangent of every polygon vertex and edge residual term the Biot point jet differentiates, and its write scope names nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py first, but git diff e74d8fce..553c9fadf touches no polygonanalytic.py: the delivered tangents cover momentchannel.factorise, _pole_contraction and Channel.across plus gradedresidual.graded_residual, _regularised and _model_integral only, and the fragment records the polygon vertex and edge residual terms (the _Vertex and _Edge terms, arsinh_terms, flux_moment_residuals, _first_residual, _second_residual, _Edge.terms) and Channel.split as outstanding. Two of the five named groups landed; the namesake deliverable is deferred to a follow-on while the manifest reads complete.

An independent run of the reviewed run's own gate command (JAX_ENABLE_COMPILATION_CACHE=false, -m slow -k compiles) at 553c9fadf measured factorise primal 0.068 s / tangent 0.220 s = 3.23, so test_tangent_compiles_within_three_primals[factorise] FAILED (1 failed, 6 passed), against gate-compile.log's 2.61. Six factorise-only repeats of the same row in isolation measured 2.82, 2.58, 2.50, 2.44, 2.79 and 2.47 (all passing), so the row passes alone but the full seven-row arm -- the command the done-when and the reviewed log actually run -- breaches the 3.0 bound; done-when (4) is not robustly met for factorise, where the primal is 88 equations compiling in about 0.07 s and process-spawn noise is a multiple of the difference.

_quotient_tangent is declared byte-identically here and at nova/biot/momentchannel.py:529, and _product_tangent (line 224) and _quotient_tangent are re-declared rather than reused from nova/biot/completeelliptic.py:351/359, which already carry them at the reviewed base e74d8fce and which nova/biot/elliptic.py:57 imports; the done-when directs reusing the elliptic tangents. The gradedresidual form is deliberately ordered as jax.jvp orders it (its docstring says so), so it cannot simply alias completeelliptic's _tangent_sum form, but the two byte-identical copies inside this single node are avoidable.

done-when (2) forbids masking near-singular inputs and directs that where the base jax.jvp is itself non-finite the comparison be against a higher-precision reference and said so; instead _denominator_domain removes the 0.42 percent factorise corner (where pivot + sqrt(pivot^2 + 4 offset) cancels) and the 1.00 percent graded samples at radius 1e-300 from the sampled domain, so every row's covered_fraction=1.000 holds over a narrowed domain and the excluded corner is reasoned about in the fragment rather than measured.

the after_suite head arm names revision 9e8332d986 (elliptic) and f09950bec (kernel, traced), neither at the reviewed head 553c9fadf, and the delta covers three modules (test_elliptic_tangent_recurrences, test_kernel_compile_cost, test_traced_section_moments) rather than the 'tests/biot plus the elliptic tests' of done-when (5); two commits sit after the head arm, one of which (c95e3e680) changes this node's own test module, so the manifest's after_suite revision does not name the reviewed tree.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call site: the new tangents are private and referenced only by each other and by the test module; the custom_jvp wrapping of the point jet is deferred to a later node.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit: 8a8c2d612 adds the tangent vocabulary and the pole-contraction, deflation, contraction and graded-residual tangents, 2baf47c37 and e82290330 reorder them to match the primal program, 14642612d adds the Channel.across tangent, f09950bec drops the masked selects, c95e3e680 samples the factorisations as the reduction forms them, and the docs commits 9e8332d98 and 553c9fadf write the fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for tangents of every function the jet differentiates in the three modules including the vertex and edge residual terms, arsinh residuals and incomplete moments; a 1e-13 identity over 10,000 unmasked samples; a one-term truncation control; a cold compile within 3x on all_debug in one job; primal bit-identity and a tests/biot delta; the test module and the fragment. I reproduced 15 passed at 553c9fadf and the negative control's 7 failed EXIT=1, and audit-doc reports 0 errors; but no polygonanalytic term and no Channel.split is delivered, done-when (2)'s non-finite corner was excluded rather than compared at higher precision, the factorise compile bound failed an independent run (3.23), and the head suite covers three modules rather than tests/biot.
item_verdicts.goal_fidelity: the node goal (prompt.txt:30) is the tangent of every polygon vertex and edge residual term the Biot point jet differentiates; the diff adds tangents for momentchannel.factorise, _pole_contraction and Channel.across and gradedresidual.graded_residual, _regularised and _model_integral (nova/biot/momentchannel.py:529, nova/biot/gradedresidual.py:219) but no polygonanalytic.py term, and the fragment records the vertex and edge residuals and Channel.split as outstanding.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, nine commits, per-row identity, truncation, compile and primal numbers with their logs, and a suite delta of zero base failures to zero head failures; it names the polygon vertex and edge terms as outstanding under follow_ons.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares six paths; git diff e74d8fce..553c9fadf touches nova/biot/momentchannel.py, nova/biot/gradedresidual.py, tests/biot/test_vertex_edge_tangent_recurrences.py and the fragment, all inside the declared scope, with nothing outside the goal and a clean reviewed worktree.

justifications.durability: the identity and the truncation control are self-falsifying: the test loads the base functions from git at e74d8fce under their own module names, asserts the primal bit-identical leaf by leaf, and the one-term truncations redden all seven identity rows; but the compile guard that would certify done-when (4) is variance-dominated at the factorise row and breached under independent reproduction, so the guard does not reliably certify the claim it exists to check.
justifications.evidence: tests/biot/test_vertex_edge_tangent_recurrences.py compares each tangent against jax.jvp of the base revision loaded through git show (an independent source), asserts primal bit-identity, and its truncation rows fire; I reproduced 15 passed at 553c9fadf and the NOVA_TANGENT_TRUNCATION=1 control's 7 failed EXIT=1, and audit-doc reports 0 errors. But the factorise cold-compile bound failed an independent run at head (3.23 > 3.0, 1 failed 6 passed), the sampled domain was narrowed away from the non-finite corner instead of being measured against a higher-precision reference, and the head suite covers three modules.
justifications.fit: the added helpers are private, follow the module's existing private-helper idiom, and carry no plan, stage or ticket label; the test module and the fragment obey the project's naming and evidence conventions.
justifications.goal_fidelity: momentchannel and gradedresidual carry correct hand-written tangents for the seven functions the fragment names, reproducing jax.jvp of the base exactly, but the node's namesake goal -- the polygon vertex and edge residual term tangents -- is not delivered: no polygonanalytic.py line changes and Channel.split is absent, so two of the five named groups landed and the rest are deferred.
justifications.reuse: the base already carries _product_tangent and _quotient_tangent in nova/biot/completeelliptic.py:351/359, imported by nova/biot/elliptic.py:57, yet gradedresidual.py and momentchannel.py re-declare them, and _quotient_tangent appears twice byte-identically within this node; the done-when expressly said to reuse the elliptic tangents.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff e74d8fce..553c9fadf touches only nova/biot/momentchannel.py, nova/biot/gradedresidual.py, tests/biot/test_vertex_edge_tangent_recurrences.py and the fragment, all inside the manifest write scope, with nothing outside the goal and a clean reviewed worktree.
